title: 72 Hour Survival Checklist
description: Item-by-item checklists for water, food, shelter, light and power, first aid, communication, tools, and sanitation, each with urban and rural additions. Also covers infants, elderly, and pets, a quick go-bag pack list, and a quarterly maintenance routine.
shortDescription: Water, food, power, medical, and tool lists with urban and rural add-ons
